name: Official Three r160 clipping stencil reference
changes: Reference HTML and LICENSE are byte-identical to upstream. HTML has a .txt suffix for inert documentation; it is never loaded or executed by the museum.
integration: pottery-studio.js adapts only the two opposing stencil passes, NotEqual cap and clearStencil ordering. One horizontal plane; shared original geometry; quaternion orientation avoids horizontal lookAt degeneracy; owned materials/cap are disposed. No upstream GUI, controls, renderer or animation loop is copied.
